title: Joe's Slow Cooker Pulled Pork (Instant Pot slow cook)
description: Joe's own pulled pork: bone-in pork butt with a Yellowstone/Weber rub, candied jalapenos, and El Yucateco XXXtra Hot, slow cooked on HIGH for 8 hours.

ingredients.note: a little over 1/3 cup Yellowstone Rancher's All Purpose, the rest Weber Original Dry Rub

steps: Coat the pork with the rub and jalapenos and set it in the pot. No added liquid.
Slow cook on HIGH for 8 hours with the non-vented glass lid on.
At the 2-hour mark, pour the 1 tbsp El Yucateco XXXtra Hot over the top of the meat.
When a fork slides in clean, shred, pull the bone, and serve.
source: Joe (his own recipe, sent via Thrifty; saved by Meal Plan)
notes: Joe's own recipe, given Oct 23, 2026. Cook note (Oct 23): the meat makes its own juice, about halfway up the butt by the end. Toss the shredded pork with some of those pot juices so it doesn't dry out.
